title: Animate scale and position with CapCut Desktop keyframes
note: In CapCut desktop, choose a clip on the timeline and locate the diamond-shaped keyframe control beside Position, Scale, Rotation or Opacity. Set an initial value, move the playhead and change that property again. The movement interpolates between the keyframes.

title: Remove a green screen with CapCut Desktop
note: Add your green-screen shot above the desired background on the timeline, select it and open Video > Remove BG > Chroma Key. Pick the background color and adjust key strength and edge/shadow controls until the subject is clean. Mobile and web layouts differ.

title: Build a speed ramp in CapCut
note: Select the clip and open Speed > Curve in CapCut Desktop. Choose a preset or customize points along the curve to alternate fast and slow motion. Preview the result to align the speed change with the action and audio.

title: Stabilize shaky clips in CapCut
note: For CapCut's online video editor, select the clip and find Stabilize under Basic video settings, then choose the available smoothing intensity and preview the result. Desktop and mobile controls can differ, so check the version and platform before applying the exact path.

title: Apply a clip mask in CapCut Desktop
note: In CapCut desktop, select the timeline clip, open the Video settings and choose Mask. Use the mask controls to limit visibility to a specific region and then position it over another layer. The main CapCut editing guide documents this desktop workflow.
